# One object and one open question

Kept the first cracked bowl and the mug Mum uses. The rest of the pottery shelf is ordinary tableware now. [[Pottery]] has one open question about lighter handles; it does not need a production plan. At the end of a year, an interest can stay alive without being converted into another project.
